notes.title: Women's day Stream
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

Our first stream to celebrate women developers will start at 7PM BST tomorrow.
We'll be doing a dev Q&A as our writer and artist playthrough the first few chapters!

During this stream you can expect:
- How the power of simps lead to the creation of the DLC
- Lots of bloopers that happened during development
- How things have evolved since our first itch version of the game
